{{Quote|This young lady is, like yourself, an otherworlder, and has expressed an interest in meeting the famous pilot. I plucked her from work today so that she might do so.|Minister of Cognitive Machinery to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="soa" />}}
This '''unknown male''' with a wispy-beard was an [[Adumari]] who served as the [[Minister of Cognitive Machinery]] for the nation of [[Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].<ref name="soa" />

During [[Red Flight]]'s&mdash;a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] group&mdash;diplomatic visit to Adumar, the minister went to one of the events hosted by the Cartann [[perator]], [[Pekaelic ke Teldan]]. The minister was accompanied by [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]], a [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] agent, who at that time was working undercover. He took great delight in introducing her to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], one of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] from Red Flight.<ref name="soa" />
